Trimmed copies of real responses captured on 14 Nov 2026 (items cut down to a few;
the XBRL item's description is shortened). Used only by the tests.

nse_equity_l.csv and nse_sme_equity_l.csv are real rows from NSE's lists (19 Nov 2026).
bse_scrips.csv is synthetic: an assumed layout for BSE's "List of Scrips" download, with
one invented company (Example Bse Only Ltd, ISIN INE000X01010).
